claims.claim: TypeAdapter is a Pydantic class that allows you to create an object with methods for validating, serializing, and producing JSON schemas for arbitrary types
TypeAdapter serves as a complete replacement for the deprecated `parse_obj_as` and `schema_of` utility functions from Pydantic V1
TypeAdapter has a `validate_python()` method to validate data against a type
TypeAdapter has a `json_schema()` method to generate JSON schemas for types
TypeAdapter supports configuration via the `config` argument using `ConfigDict`
TypeAdapter supports `defer_build=True` to defer schema building until first use
TypeAdapter has a `rebuild()` method to manually trigger schema building
Each time a TypeAdapter is instantiated, it will construct a new validator and serializer
It is a performance best practice to instantiate TypeAdapter once and reuse it rather than creating new instances repeatedly
Configuration cannot be provided if the type adapter directly wraps a type that has its own config (BaseModel, TypedDict, or dataclass)
If you need configuration with types like BaseModel, TypedDict, or dataclass, you need to set `__pydantic_config__` on the type itself

cases.query: GZipMiddleware

claims.claim: GZipMiddleware handles GZip compression of responses for any request that includes "gzip" in the Accept-Encoding header
GZipMiddleware can handle both standard and streaming responses
minimum_size argument prevents GZipping of responses smaller than the specified size in bytes with a default of 500
compresslevel is an integer ranging from 1 to 9 used during GZip compression with a default of 9
Lower compresslevel values result in faster compression but larger file sizes
Higher compresslevel values result in slower compression but smaller file sizes
thread_minimum_size compresses body chunks at least this large in a worker thread to keep the event loop responsive with a default of 131072 (128 KiB)
exclude_content_types specifies content types that are never compressed
exclude_content_types defaults to DEFAULT_EXCLUDED_CONTENT_TYPES which includes text/event-stream and already-compressed formats
The middleware won't GZip responses that already have a Content-Encoding set
The middleware won't GZip partial content responses (status 206)
The middleware won't GZip responses with a Content-Type in exclude_content_types
For streaming responses, the middleware compresses and emits output for every chunk the application sends
For streaming responses, chunks reach the client as they are produced
For streaming responses, this approach favors timely delivery over compression ratio
GZipMiddleware can be imported from fastapi
GZipMiddleware can be imported from starlette.middleware.gzip
